description: Direct evaluations of managed Unity 2019.4 math (UnityEngine.CoreModule IL: Mathf/Vector3/Quaternion operators; float32) and KSP double-precision math (Vector3d, UnityEngine.QuaternionD in Assembly-CSharp, UtilMath, Planetarium.CelestialFrame). Columns a0..a5 are inputs, r0..r3 outputs; unused slots are null. Note: Mathf functions that wrap System.Math use the .NET Framework CRT here, not Unity's Mono/UCRT, so transcendental results may differ by 1 ulp from in-game values.

provenance.float_semantics: IEEE-754 binary32/binary64, SSE2 (RyuJIT x64); libm from the .NET Framework CLR, not Unity's Mono
